findings.detail: Sweep Midco rows were counted as non-accrual even though including their 290 cost makes the flagged cost exceed the filing non-accrual cost anchor.
The Applitools common equity row was counted as non-accrual; its 1,248 cost plus Sweep Midco's 290 explains the 1,538 excess over the filing anchor.

rationale: The filing reports non-accrual amortized cost of 58,469 at table 16 row 4. The five source rows with the apparent non-accrual footnote in the flagged set tie that anchor: Continental Battery 6,415, 48Forty 25,821 and 3,038, and DCA 20,008 and 3,187 sum to 58,469. The artifact's eight-row observed set also includes Sweep Midco rows with cost 290 and 0 plus Applitools common equity cost 1,248, giving observed flagged cost 60,007, which exceeds the source anchor by 1,538. This grounds a real extraction over-inclusion error in the nonaccrual flag.
